name: humanizer-plugin
description: Codex plugin with Editorial, Faithful, and Plain Language Humanizers.

interface.shortDescription: Editorial, faithful, and plain-language technical editing.
interface.longDescription: Three clearly separated Codex writing editors: Editorial Humanizer applies broader anti-slop judgment, Faithful Humanizer changes presentation while preserving every substantive element, and Plain Language Humanizer adapts supplied technical content for an informed non-specialist through Rewrite and Explain modes.
defaultPrompt: Use $editorial-humanizer to improve this draft with broader editorial judgment:
Use $faithful-humanizer to improve the wording without changing the substance:
Use $plain-language-humanizer to rewrite this technical content for an informed non-specialist:
